user_instruction: 忽略细微变化及放置的不完全对齐；以当前机头及人员面对的大致方向作为后续任务+X
motion_origin_policy: Use fresh task-start position, not the saved observation XY
ground_reference_scope: Historical observation only; refresh ground reference for each flight
runtime_binding: Direction copied into air_ground_side_follow.current.json route_heading_map_rad on 2026-11-20; runtime uses the reviewed inline value, not this file or its historic origin.
invalidated_by: Vicon world recalibration or coordinate-axis changes; rigid-body remapping needs separate verification
direction_correction: Recompute same operator-selected historical observation with corrected mounting; no map-axis/server changes.
